lines.lyric_hangul: 그 예쁜 웃음 간직하며 언제나 빛나길
lines.lyric_translation: Hope you always shine with that pretty smile

lines.lyric: Kkeutkkaji neon areumdaweotgo
lines.lyric_hangul: 끝까지 넌 아름다웠고
lines.lyric_translation: You were beautiful till the end

lines.lyric: Yeojeonhi meongcheonghan naman yeogi namasseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 여전히 멍청한 나만 여기 남았어
lines.lyric_translation: Stupid me is all that remains here

lines.lyric: Geuttae deo mani jalhaejulgeol
lines.lyric_hangul: 그때 더 많이 잘해줄걸
lines.lyric_translation: Should have treated you better back then

lines.lyric: Jinbuhan maldeulman baetgo hansum neureojyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 진부한 말들만 뱉고 한숨 늘어져
lines.lyric_translation: After saying these obvious words I give out long sigh

lines.lyric_hangul: 시간을 되돌려 처음부터 다시 시작하고 싶다 벌써
lines.lyric_translation: I want to rewind time / And start all over already

lines.lyric: Eojireopge manggajin i sanghwangeul jaeguseong
lines.lyric_hangul: 어지럽게 망가진 이 상황을 재구성
lines.lyric_translation: Reorganize this chaotically destroyed situation

lines.lyric_hangul: 하고 행복하기만 했던 그때로 가고 싶었지만 너무 멀어
lines.lyric_translation: And go back to the time when I was happy / But it’s too far away

lines.lyric: Mami ije byeonhaetta
lines.lyric_hangul: 맘이 이제 변했다
lines.lyric_translation: My mind has changed

lines.lyric: Useumeul jitji anatgo geu gamjeongdeuri modu shigeotta
lines.lyric_hangul: 웃음을 짓지 않았고 그 감정들이 모두 식었다
lines.lyric_translation: I didn’t smile and all emotions turned cold

lines.lyric: Doragal suga eopseotta
lines.lyric_hangul: 돌아갈 수가 없었다
lines.lyric_translation: I couldn’t go back

lines.lyric_hangul: 슬프게 말을 건네는 널 보며 되려 괜찮다 위로를 해
lines.lyric_translation: As you talk to me sadly / I rather comfort you

lines.lyric: Geugeo da jayeonseureon irirago
lines.lyric_hangul: 그거 다 자연스런 일이라고
lines.lyric_translation: That everything happens naturally

lines.lyric: Igeon jeoldae ne jalmot aninikka ulji ma
lines.lyric_hangul: 이건 절대 네 잘못 아니니까 울지 마
lines.lyric_translation: This is never your fault so don’t cry

lines.lyric: Nunmul heulliji malgo geuttaecheoreom
lines.lyric_hangul: 눈물 흘리지 말고 그때처럼
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t shed tears and like those times

lines.lyric: Useojweo neon useul ttaega jeil yeppeunikka
lines.lyric_hangul: 웃어줘 넌 웃을 때가 제일 예쁘니까
lines.lyric_translation: Smile, because you’re the prettiest when you smile
